notice: Personal portfolio demo. Fictional data. Not legal or billing advice.

totals.at_risk_rule: Per entry: largest single reduction among open findings, capped at the entry amount. Invoice: the larger of the per-entry sum and the largest invoice-level amount, capped at the sum of the lines.

not_checked: BRW-RECEIPT-01 (Receipt threshold): 2 expense line(s) at or over the threshold could not be checked because the file does not say whether a receipt is attached

findings.source_quote: Total compensation under this Agreement shall not exceed the not-to-exceed amount stated in the task order, and Counsel shall not be paid for any amount above it without a written amendment.
findings.explanation: Billed to date ($52,242.00) plus this invoice ($9,608.00) is $61,850.00. The cap is $60,000.00, so $1,850.00 is over it.
findings.suggested_fix: Raise the overage with the client before sending the bill. An amendment or written approval may be needed.

findings.entry_narrative: Telephone conference with general counsel regarding protest timeline
findings.source_quote: Time submitted more than 90 days after the date of service shall not be paid.
findings.explanation: The work is dated 2026-07-28, 100 days before the invoice date. The limit is 90 days.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client whether it will accept the late time, or write it off.

findings.entry_narrative: Review agency procurement file; draft chronology of bid protest events; email to agency counsel regarding gaps
findings.source_quote: Any entry of more than 0.5 hour that combines two or more tasks shall be returned unpaid.
findings.explanation: The narrative appears to describe 3 tasks under one time total of 2.2 hours.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to enter each task on its own line with its own time. Tasks the check detected: (1) Review agency procurement file. (2) draft chronology of bid protest events. (3) email to agency counsel regarding gaps. The tool does not know how the time divides between them and does not rewrite the narrative.

findings.entry_narrative: Travel to pump station site inspection
findings.source_quote: Travel time shall not be compensated unless the General Counsel has approved the travel in writing in advance.
findings.explanation: Travel time with no client approval on record for this matter.
findings.suggested_fix: Obtain and record the client's approval, or move the travel time off the bill.

findings.source_quote: Secretarial, clerical and file-management tasks are included in the hourly rates and shall not be billed separately.
findings.explanation: The narrative contains "Organizing files", which is on this client's list of non-billable clerical work.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entry off the bill, or ask the timekeeper whether the description is accurate.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft exhibit list for protest hearing
findings.source_quote: Each time entry shall identify the phase of the approved budget by task code.
findings.explanation: The entry has no task code.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the missing code. The timekeeper or billing staff should choose it; the check does not guess.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft table of bid submission dates from procurement file
findings.source_quote: The Agency shall not pay twice for the same service, and duplicate entries shall be struck.
findings.explanation: Same timekeeper, date, quantity and description as line 20.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm with the timekeeper whether the work was done twice. If not, remove one entry.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft written discovery to protesting bidder
findings.source_quote: Time shall be recorded in increments of one-tenth of an hour.
findings.explanation: 1.25 hours is not a multiple of the 0.1 hour increment.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to restate the time in 0.1 hour increments from their own records.

findings.source_quote: Fees billed to any phase of the approved budget shall not exceed the amount allotted to that phase.
findings.explanation: Phase L300: billed to date ($18,225.00) plus this invoice ($2,415.00) is $640.00 over the phase amount of $20,000.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Raise the phase overage with the client before sending the bill.

findings.source_quote: Meals shall be reimbursed at no more than $45.00 per person per day and lodging at no more than $160.00 per night.
findings.explanation: The lodging cost of $189.00 per unit is over the client's cap of $160.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Reduce the expense to the cap. The check reads each unit as one person-day (meals) or one night (lodging).

findings.entry_narrative: Draft response to bid protest letter from unsuccessful bidder
findings.source_quote: Counsel shall bill only at the hourly rates listed in Exhibit B.
findings.explanation: Billed at $295.00 an hour. The approved rate for this timekeeper is $280.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the rate to the approved rate card, or attach the client's approval of the higher rate.

summary: Draft invoice INV-B-2001 for Brackenmoor Regional Water Agency (matter BRW-2026-03) totals $9,608.00 across 28 lines. The check ran 13 confirmed client rules plus the arithmetic checks. It found 11 open findings on 9 lines: 8 will likely be rejected, 3 likely reduced and 0 for review. The amount at risk is $2,378.50, or 24.8% of the invoice, counting each line once at its largest single reduction. 1 check could not be completed from the file; see the report. Every finding is a prompt for review; nothing on the bill has been changed.
